note: Own explicit projection rules; this is not an original WAI-ARIA schema.

selection.ariaActivedescendant: Current existing option for activeKey; absent without active option.
selection.ariaSelected: True only for the active option; this does not commit value.
selection.ariaDisabled: Equals result.disabled; disabled options cannot become active or committed.

focus: Input retains DOM focus during keyboard navigation. Popup/viewport get no extra role or tabstop.
statusPlacement: After visible popup, otherwise after input; statusGap and lineHeight from tokens.
designTarget: Represent the named parts, label, status text, active and disabled styles. These are semantic annotations, not a claim of screenreader behaviour on a design canvas.
